details:
Please consider adding an option to toggle the Face Mirror between Mirrored and Unmirrored views.

The Face Mirror now behaves like a real mirror and horizontally flips the avatar. While this makes sense for users who want an actual mirror, the previous unmirrored view was also very useful, especially for avatar creators and users with asymmetrical avatars.

An unmirrored view preserves the avatar's actual left/right orientation as seen by other players, and also matches the appearance we are familiar with when working on the avatar in Unity.

For avatars with asymmetrical hairstyles, accessories, clothing, facial details, or other left/right differences, horizontal mirroring can significantly change the visual impression of the avatar.

Rather than replacing the current mirrored behavior, I would like to suggest adding a simple option such as:

Mirrored — behaves like a real mirror

Unmirrored / Camera View — shows the avatar without horizontal flipping

This would allow users to choose whichever view best fits their use case, while keeping the current mirror behavior available for people who prefer it.

Thank you for considering it!
title: Please add a Mirrored / Unmirrored toggle to the Face Mirror
